caption: The drawing depicts a round dish or plate with a decorative handle attached at the top, all rendered in shades of grey pencil on an off-white background. The main circular body of the dish has a shallow, central depression and two concentric raised bands. The handle is ornate, featuring symmetrical, scrolling cut-out shapes with a rounded top and additional curved details at the sides. At the center of the handle, the characters "R" and "I" are inscribed vertically, with the "R" above the "I". The drawing is enclosed within a faint, rectangular border. In the lower left corner is a small square containing the letters "DMV" in a bold, serif font, and the name “Hesler Duany” is written just below it. In the lower right corner, there is a small inset sketch showing a side view outline of the same dish, indicating its profile and proportions, with the letters "DMV" marked on the side. The overall composition is balanced and precise, using shading to depict the contours and depth of the objects.
